## 12. FRAUD & UNAUTHORIZED TRANSACTIONS  
### 12.1 Your Responsibility  
You must:
- Protect your PIN and password
- Report fraud/suspicious activity immediately
- Use ATMs in safe locations
- Don't share security details
name: Chunk 31/42

raw_entities.name: Customer Fraud Prevention Obligation
raw_entities.description: Contractual obligation requiring customers to protect their PIN and password, report fraud or suspicious activity immediately, use ATMs in safe locations, and refrain from sharing security details. This clause establishes the customer's affirmative duties to prevent unauthorized access and fraud.
context: You must: Protect your PIN and password

raw_entities.name: Fraud Detection and Reporting Obligation
raw_entities.description: The bank's requirement that customers report fraud and suspicious activity immediately. This establishes the procedural obligation for customers to notify the bank of potential unauthorized transactions or security breaches without delay.

raw_entities.name: PIN and Password Protection
raw_entities.description: A security requirement that customers must protect their PIN and password to prevent unauthorized account access. This is a foundational security control that customers are obligated to maintain.

raw_entities.name: Secure ATM Usage Requirement
raw_entities.description: A security guideline requiring customers to use ATMs only in safe locations to reduce the risk of fraud, theft, or unauthorized access to their accounts.

raw_entities.name: Security Detail Non-Disclosure Obligation
raw_entities.description: A security requirement prohibiting customers from sharing security details with any third party. This protects account integrity by ensuring that sensitive authentication information remains confidential.
